title: Turner's Small Watercolor Kits
content: J.M.W. Turner's super-portable watercolor set consisted of a small set of cake colors in a leather pocket pouch.He also had slightly larger sets with flasks. This is his paintbox, found in his studio after his death in 1851(Tate Archive 7315.6)To learn more about 19th century watercolor sets, check out the websitewhimsie.comor theTate Archive
